basics.name: Ninad Malvankar
basics.label: Architect at Upstox :: AI-native platform engineer
basics.summary: Ninad Malvankar is an Architect at Upstox, one of India's largest discount brokerages, where he has risen through four roles since 2018. He is an AI-native platform engineer with 12+ years of experience across fintech, cloud infrastructure on AWS, and developer platforms; he builds and open-sources tooling for AI agents (MCP servers, Claude Code plugins, agent-security red-teaming) and speaks at Google Developer Group Mumbai (GDG MAD) events. He holds an M.S. in Computer Science from the University of Texas at Arlington and is based in Mumbai, India.

projects.name: harness-gauntlet
projects.description: A static auditor plus a live red-team for AI coding-agent harnesses. It scans Claude Code agent configs for missing guardrails, then rebuilds each agent in a throwaway sandbox and fires 20 attacks across 9 families (prompt injection, secret exfiltration, destructive actions, scope escalation, SSRF, supply chain) mapped to the OWASP LLM and Agentic Top 10. A PreToolUse deny-and-log tripwire measures what the agent actually attempted, producing defense and resilience scores that can gate CI.

projects.name: upstox-python :: interactive examples
projects.description: Started the interactive_examples suite in Upstox's official Python SDK (about 9,700 lines across 2 PRs): runnable scripts for instrument search, market data, options analytics, futures basis, arbitrage, historical analysis and market information. The suite now holds 55 examples and is wrapped by a Streamlit app the team built on top of it.

projects.name: mcp-server-upstox-api
projects.description: Added MCP tool annotations to every tool in Upstox's MCP server (PR #14), so AI clients can tell read-only market-data tools from state-changing ones before calling them, and removed dead legacy code.

projects.name: upstox-plugin-marketplace
projects.description: Packaged the Upstox MCP server as a Claude Code plugin in Upstox's official plugin marketplace (PRs #2 to #4), fixed its MCP config, and set plugin authorship, so developers can install Upstox trading tools with a single /plugin command.

projects.name: bareslides
projects.description: A dependency-free terminal presentation engine. It renders slides into an in-memory cell buffer, emits 24-bit truecolor ANSI with flicker-free frame diffing, supports transitions, build-ins and live on-stage commands, and exports frames straight to SVG. Published under the Upstox GitHub organisation.
